title: HPE security advisory (AV26-1119)
description: As of November 3, 2026, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
HPE Networking Fabric Composer (AFC)
	Prior to 7.3.5
Prior to 7.4.1

HPE Networking Virtual Intranet Access (VIA)
	Prior to 4.7.9
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
